goal.en: Go to Zoe's party and make a new friend.
goal.zh: 參加柔伊的派對，交一個新朋友。

background: cozy apartment living room at night with warm string lights, a sofa with colorful cushions, a low table with bowls of chips and paper cups, a record player, potted plants

intro.en: Saturday night. Last time you said "Maybe next time." Zoe invited you again, and this time you said yes.
intro.zh: 星期六晚上。上次你說「下次吧」，這次柔伊又約你，你答應了。

intro.en: You knock on her door with a box of cookies. Music and laughter come from inside.
intro.zh: 你帶著一盒餅乾敲門，屋裡傳來音樂和笑聲。

lines.en: Kai, you made it! Come on in!

choices.en: Thanks for having me! I brought some cookies.
choices.zh: 謝謝你邀請我！我帶了一些餅乾。
choices.tip: Thanks for having me! 是到別人家作客時最自然的開場白。

choices.en: Hi! How much is the party? I can pay now.
choices.zh: 嗨！派對多少錢？我現在付。

lines.en: Pay? Kai, this is my home, not a restaurant!
lines.zh: 付錢？凱，這是我家，不是餐廳啦！

story.en: For the rest of the night, Zoe calls you "the customer" and asks if you want a receipt.
story.zh: 整個晚上柔伊都叫你「這位客人」，還問你要不要打統編。

fail.why: 朋友在家辦的 house party 通常不收錢，帶點零食或飲料就是禮貌。一進門就問價錢，主人會覺得你把她家當成餐廳。

choices.en: Thanks for have me! I bring some cookies.
choices.zh: 謝謝你邀請我！我帶了一些餅乾。

lines.en: You bring cookies... every day? Or just today?
lines.zh: 你帶餅乾……是每天都帶嗎？還是只有今天？

story.en: Zoe thinks you deliver cookies every Saturday. She tells all her friends about her new cookie service.
story.zh: 柔伊以為你每週六都會送餅乾來，還跟朋友宣傳她的新外送服務。

fail.why: for 後面要接動名詞：Thanks for having me.。餅乾已經帶來了，要用過去式 I brought，不是 I bring。

lines.en: Aw, thank you! Make yourself at home. Oh, here comes Finn!
lines.zh: 哇，謝謝！把這裡當自己家喔。啊，芬恩過來了！

lines.en: Hey there! I don't think we've met. I'm Finn.
lines.zh: 嗨！我們應該沒見過吧，我是芬恩。

choices.en: Hi Finn! I'm Kai. It's nice to meet you.
choices.zh: 嗨，芬恩！我是凱，很高興認識你。
choices.tip: 說出對方的名字再介紹自己，對方會覺得你有認真在聽。

choices.en: I'm Kai. Please give me more advice.

lines.en: Advice? About what? We just met!
lines.zh: 建議？關於什麼？我們才剛認識耶！

story.en: Finn gives you twenty minutes of advice about coffee beans. You now know a lot about coffee beans.
story.zh: 芬恩給了你二十分鐘的咖啡豆建議，你現在對咖啡豆非常了解。

fail.why: 「請多指教」是中文的客套話，直翻成 please give me more advice，對方會以為你真的要請教他問題。英文說 Nice to meet you! 就夠了。

choices.en: Hi, I'm Kai. How old are you?

lines.en: Uh... old enough to be at this party?
lines.zh: 呃……夠大可以參加這個派對了吧？

story.en: Finn jokes that you work as a security guard. Everyone holds up their phones to show you their "ID."
story.zh: 芬恩開玩笑說你是派對保全，大家紛紛拿出手機假裝給你看「證件」。

fail.why: 在台灣問年紀是為了知道怎麼稱呼對方，但在英語文化裡，初次見面就問年齡很突兀。先聊名字、工作、興趣就好。

lines.en: Nice to meet you too, Kai. So, how do you know Zoe?
lines.zh: 我也很高興認識你，凱。所以，你怎麼認識柔伊的？

choices.en: We're classmates at the language school.
choices.zh: 我們是語言學校的同學。
choices.tip: How do you know...? 問的是你們的關係，回答 We're classmates. 或 We work together. 就好。

choices.en: I know her a little. She's very nice and funny.
choices.zh: 我跟她有點熟，她人很好又很好笑。

lines.en: Ha, she is! But where did you two meet?
lines.zh: 哈，她真的是！不過你們是在哪裡認識的？

story.en: Finn thinks you're Zoe's biggest fan. He asks if you want her autograph.
story.zh: 芬恩以為你是柔伊的頭號粉絲，問你要不要她的簽名。

fail.why: How do you know Zoe? 不是問你多了解她，而是問你們怎麼認識的。回答關係就好：We're classmates.。

choices.en: Why? Why do you want to know?

lines.en: Whoa, sorry. I was just making conversation.
lines.zh: 哇，抱歉。我只是想找話聊而已。

story.en: Finn slowly walks back to the chip bowl. Now the whole party thinks you're a spy.
story.zh: 芬恩慢慢退回洋芋片旁邊，現在整個派對都以為你是間諜。

fail.why: 在派對上，How do you know...? 只是開話題的標準問句，沒有要打聽隱私。反問 Why? 聽起來很防備，像在審問對方。

lines.en: Cool! I work with Zoe at a café downtown. Where are you from, Kai?
lines.zh: 酷！我跟柔伊在市區的咖啡店一起上班。凱，你是哪裡人？

choices.en: I'm from Taiwan. How about you?
choices.tip: 回答完再問一句 How about you?，對話就能自然地接下去。

choices.en: I'm come from Taiwan. It's a small island.
choices.zh: 我來自台灣，那是一個小島。

lines.en: Oh, did you just come from Taiwan? Like, today?
lines.zh: 喔，你剛從台灣過來嗎？今天才到？

story.en: Finn asks if you have jet lag and brings you a glass of water. You've lived here for months.
story.zh: 芬恩問你有沒有時差，還幫你倒了杯水。你明明已經住在這裡好幾個月了。

fail.why: I'm from 和 I come from 選一個說就好，不能疊成 I'm come from。最自然的說法是 I'm from Taiwan.。

choices.en: I'm Taiwan people. Do you know Taiwan?
choices.zh: 我是台灣人。你知道台灣嗎？

lines.en: Taiwan people? You're... a whole group of people?
lines.zh: 台灣人們？你一個人是……一整群人？

story.en: Finn laughs and introduces you as "the Ambassador of Taiwan." Everyone at the party bows when you walk by.
story.zh: 芬恩笑著介紹你是「台灣大使」，之後你經過時大家都向你鞠躬。

fail.why: 「台灣人」直翻成 Taiwan people 是中式英文，people 是複數。說 I'm Taiwanese. 或 I'm from Taiwan. 才對。

lines.en: I'm from right here in Maple Bay. Taiwan, huh? I love bubble tea!
lines.zh: 我就是楓灣本地人。台灣啊？我超愛珍珠奶茶！

lines.en: See? I knew you two would get along!
lines.zh: 看吧？我就知道你們會合得來！

story.en: Finn introduces you to everyone at the party. Before you leave, he invites you on his next photo walk around the city.
story.zh: 芬恩帶你認識派對上的每個人。你離開前，他還邀你參加他下次的城市攝影散步。

notes.explain: 到別人家、參加派對或活動時的固定說法，進門或離開時都可以說。

example.en: Thanks for having me! Your place is so cozy.
example.zh: 謝謝你邀請我！你家好溫馨。

notes.explain: 派對上跟陌生人開話題最常用的問題，問的是你們的關係。回答 We're classmates. 或 We work together. 就好。

example.en: How do you know Finn? / We work together.
example.zh: 你怎麼認識芬恩的？／我們是同事。

notes.explain: 兩種說法擇一，不能疊成 I'm come from。口語最常用 I'm from...。說國籍可以用 I'm Taiwanese.。

example.zh: 我來自台灣，我是台灣人。

notes.explain: 中文問年紀常是為了決定稱呼，但英語文化裡初次見面問年齡、薪水、感情狀況都太私人。先聊工作、興趣、怎麼認識主人。

example.en: So, what do you do for fun?

notes.zh: 很高興認識你（不是「請多指教」）。
notes.explain: 「請多指教」是客套話，直翻成 Please give me more advice. 會讓對方以為你要請教問題。英文自我介紹說 Nice to meet you! 就夠了。

example.en: Hi, I'm Kai. Nice to meet you!
example.zh: 嗨，我是凱，很高興認識你！
